title: Statistical Methods for Analytics
description: Focus on advanced statistical techniques for a career in data science or business analytics. Covers the use of writing probabilistic models for data-generating processes, using Bayesian Methods/MCMC to solve such problems. Emphasizes problem identification and general problem-solving tools. Special Topics: Survival Analysis, Missing Data, Robust Statistics, Sequential Analysis, Multiple Testing. Assignments are case-based
